source_of_truth: Operator directive 2026-06-08: dogfooding the full orchestrate loop on DontPanic surfaced four pre-impl governance defects (sufficiency audit has no production caller; lock requires an artifact it cannot generate; design-review volley crashes on Category serialization; sufficiency parser discards paid Codex JSONL output). Fix all four, TDD, with a no-paid fixture replaying the wasted Codex response and an end-to-end dry-run, then audit via the working post-impl path.
completion_test: A gated plan runs draft → sufficiency audit (Codex output parsed, not discarded) → lock (findings generated, not dead-ended) → design-review volley (serializes without the Category crash); the post-impl audit path is unaffected and reuses the SAME Codex parser; all verified by no-paid fixtures + an end-to-end dry-run, with the full Python suite green.
